headlines.name: Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.computedReferenceTrace_poincare_aggregate
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)],
  2 ≤ U →
    7 ≤ L →
      ∀
        (hp :
          2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
        (g : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L → ℝ),
        (Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.computedReferenceTrace r c U L hr hc hp).variance g ≤
          32 *
                ↑(Fintype.card
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                        (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U))) ^
                  3 *
              Math115.AggregateDefectTrace.aggregateCT r c U *
            (Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.computedReferenceTrace r c U L hr hc hp).energy g

headlines.name: Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.computedReferenceTrace_transition
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)]
  (hp :
    2 ≤
      Fintype.card
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
  (d e : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L),
  d ≠ e →
    have i₀ := (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none;
    have j₀ := (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none;
    (Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.computedReferenceTrace r c U L hr hc hp).P d e =
      (Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.referenceDD r c U L i₀ j₀ d e +
          ∑ b,
            Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.referenceCross r c U L i₀ j₀ b d *
                Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.referenceCross r c U L i₀ j₀ b e /
              ∑ f, Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.referenceCross r c U L i₀ j₀ b f) /
        (2 * ↑(Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.defectAllowance r c U) * Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.defectWeight r c U L d)

headlines.name: Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.computedReferenceTrace_pi
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  [inst : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)]
  (hp :
    2 ≤
      Fintype.card
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
  (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L),
  (Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.computedReferenceTrace r c U L hr hc hp).π d =
    Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.defectWeight r c U L d / ∑ e, Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.defectWeight r c U L e

headlines.name: Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.referenceTrace_canonical_P
headlines.statement:
∀ {I J : Type u} [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype J] [inst_2 : LinearOrder I] [inst_3 : LinearOrder J] (r : I → ℕ)
  (c : J → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (href :
    Nonempty (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeRows r U) ∧
      Nonempty (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeColumns c U))
  [inst_4 : Nonempty (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L)]
  (hp :
    2 ≤
      Fintype.card
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
  (d e : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L),
  (Math115.ComputedReferenceTrace.referenceTrace r c U L (Classical.choice ⋯) (Classical.choice ⋯) hp).P d e =
    (Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.actualRationalTrace r c U L hp).P d e
